questions.answer:
Joe's AEO service covers five areas:

- **Visibility baseline:** Joe picks the questions your buyers or patients ask and checks which brands each AI assistant cites today. [3]
- **Content structure:** Pages are rebuilt around direct, self-contained answers and question-based headings. [3]
- **Entities and schema:** This includes organization, person, service, and medical schema, plus off-site signals that tell AI systems who you are. [3]
- **Technical access:** This covers AI crawler rules, server-rendered content, llms.txt, and page speed. [3]
- **Reporting:** Citation share across assistants is tracked monthly next to your SEO numbers. [3]
